description: Defines a simple bitset class with methods for setting, unsetting, querying bits, and finding the first set bit, with platform-specific implementations for bit scanning.

classes.name: bitset
classes.description: A lightweight bitset class with platform-specific implementations for bit scanning, providing methods to manipulate and query bits.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the bit at the specified index.

methods.name: unset
methods.description: Unsets the bit at the specified index.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns whether the bit at the specified index is set.

methods.name: is_entirely_unset
methods.description: Checks if all bits are unset.

methods.name: for_each_set_bit
methods.description: Calls a provided function for each set bit's index.

methods.name: find_first_set
methods.description: Finds the index of the first set bit, platform-specific implementation.
